basics.label: Developer activation for frontier platforms · founder, Palo Alto AI Research Lab
basics.summary: I've done developer activation for a frontier platform before — when smart contracts were where LLM agents are now. Classically trained in CS security (MEPhI), 7+ years venture founder, publishing researcher on multi-agent stability. Today I run a production multi-machine Claude fleet in public — and write the operating manual as I go. Built with Claude as implementation collaborator; I own problem framing, architecture, evaluation, product decisions and final QA.
